title: Episode 0.01 — Less Funding. Exceptional Performance.
description: Puerto Rico receives 41% less Medicare funding than the states — and yet it delivers some of the strongest Medicare Advantage quality results in the nation. How is that possible? And imagine what Puerto Rico could accomplish if Washington funded it fairly. That is exactly what The Healthcare Paradox explores: real data and real federal policy, explained in plain English — no jargon, no spin.
